description: The ECharts Stat panel beside the core Stat panel, with the same data and the same options in each row. See src/modules/stat/parity.md.

panels.title: ECharts: One value
panels.description: One series. The automatic text mode shows only the value, at the center, because the panel has a title. The sparkline fills the space below the text. The unit is a suffix with a smaller font.

panels.title: Core: One value
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Four values
panels.description: Four series in a 2 x 2 grid. Each cell shows the name above the value. All cells use the same font sizes: the sizes that fit the longest name and the longest value.

panels.title: Core: Four values
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Eight values
panels.description: Eight series. The cells are not higher than 100px, so they have no sparkline.

panels.title: Core: Eight values
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Wide layout
panels.description: A cell more than 2.5 times as wide as it is high: the name at the left, the value at the right, and the sparkline in the lower half.

panels.title: Core: Wide layout
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Wide layout off
panels.description: The same cell with Wide layout off: the name above the value.

panels.title: Core: Wide layout off
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Text mode Name
panels.description: The name is the large text. The panel shows no value.

panels.title: Core: Text mode Name
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Text mode None
panels.description: No text. The panel shows only the sparklines.

panels.title: Core: Text mode None
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Color mode None
panels.description: The value has the text color of the theme. The sparkline keeps the color of the value.

panels.title: Core: Color mode None
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Thresholds
panels.description: The color of each value and of its sparkline is the color of the threshold that the value is in: 72 is red, 65 is orange, 44 is green.

panels.title: Core: Thresholds
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Graph mode None
panels.description: No sparkline. The name and the value are at the vertical center of each cell.

panels.title: Core: Graph mode None
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Value mappings and decimals
panels.description: The standard options apply: two decimals, and a value mapping that shows the text Critical in red for the value 9.

panels.title: Core: Value mappings and decimals
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: No number field
panels.description: A table with text fields only. The ECharts panel shows the steps to fix the data. Core Stat shows No data.

panels.title: Core: No number field
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Thresholds, default color scheme
panels.description: The panel JSON has thresholds and no color scheme. The default color scheme of the panel is the thresholds scheme, so the colors are the same as in the Thresholds row: 72 is red, 65 is orange, 44 is green.

panels.title: Core: Thresholds, default color scheme
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Color mode Background Gradient
panels.description: Each cell has a gradient of the color of its threshold: red for 72, orange for 65, green for 44. The texts are light or dark for contrast, and the sparkline is a light line with a white area.

panels.title: Core: Color mode Background Gradient
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Color mode Background Solid
panels.description: Each cell has the color of its threshold as one fill: red for 72, orange for 65, green for 44. The texts are light or dark for contrast, and the sparkline is a light line with a white area.

panels.title: Core: Color mode Background Solid
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Text alignment Center
panels.description: The name of each value is above the value, and the two are at the center of the cell.

panels.title: Core: Text alignment Center
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Text alignment Center, wide
panels.description: A wide cell: the name and the value are in one row at the center of the cell, above the sparkline.

panels.title: Core: Text alignment Center, wide
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Text size
panels.description: The name of each value is 40px and the value is 60px, and not the sizes that fit the cell.

panels.title: Core: Text size
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Percent change
panels.description: Below each value is the change from the first value to the last value of the series, in percent: an arrow up and green for an increase, an arrow down and red for a decrease.

panels.title: Core: Percent change
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Percent change, centered, inverted colors
panels.description: The text alignment is Center and the percent change color mode is Inverted: red for an increase, green for a decrease.

panels.title: Core: Percent change, centered, inverted colors
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Percent change, no sparkline, same color as the value
panels.description: The graph mode is None and the percent change color mode is Same as Value. The value is smaller than with no percent change, because the percent change needs a part of the height.

panels.title: Core: Percent change, no sparkline, same color as the value
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Orientation Horizontal
panels.description: One cell for each row of the panel: the cells are as wide as the panel, one below the other.

panels.title: Core: Orientation Horizontal
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Orientation Vertical
panels.description: One cell for each column of the panel: the cells are as high as the panel, side by side. The automatic grid puts these four values in two rows.

panels.title: Core: Orientation Vertical
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Data links, one link
panels.description: Each value has one data link. The cursor on a cell is a pointer, and a click opens the link in this tab.

panels.title: Core: Data links, one link
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

panels.title: ECharts: Data links, two links
panels.description: Each value has two data links. The cursor on a cell is the menu cursor, and a click opens a menu with the group "Data links". The second link opens in a new tab.

panels.title: Core: Data links, two links
panels.description: The core Stat panel with the same data and options, for comparison.

title: ECharts Stat — basics
